single_change: Use the available outer-train prefix up to 90% for numeric fitting and its last 10% for internal epoch selection, instead of obsolete Wiki-reserved 60% fit / 10% selection / 30% unused. More fitted samples also mean more optimizer steps per epoch; this is a training-allocation experiment, not a compute-matched mechanism proof.
history_consumption: Same full 24x7 hourly tensor as v19; no subhourly side input or future NWP.
scaler_fit: Keep the exact v19 base-fit-prefix scaler (first 60% of outer train), even when the numeric fitting queue expands; verified by exact array comparison.
statistics_note: Same issue-time clustered inference as v19. Report both Persistence and the corresponding frozen v19 model; no outer-based fallback or model selection.
primary_metric: Report MAE, MSE, RMSE, R2, MAE/RMSE Persistence Skill, capacity hit rates and each of the four leads; assess MAE and RMSE jointly, without hiding harmed folds or leads.
evidence_scope: Development evidence, not an independent confirmation set. No appended hyperparameters, seeds or data cleaning based on outer results.
